Dharma.title: Dharma
Dharma.definition: Religious duty; righteousness; cosmic law; the natural order of the universe; one's prescribed responsibility

Karma.title: Karma
Karma.definition: Action and its consequences; the universal law of cause and effect; the force generated by one's actions

Yoga.title: Yoga
Yoga.definition: Union; skill in action; spiritual discipline; methods of connecting with the divine; mental discipline

Bhakti.title: Bhakti
Bhakti.definition: Devotion; loving service to the Supreme Lord; the path of devotional surrender; emotional connection to the divine

Atman.title: Atman
Atman.definition: The eternal individual soul; the self; the divine essence within all beings; consciousness itself

Brahman.title: Brahman
Brahman.definition: The ultimate reality; the absolute consciousness; the source of all existence; the infinite whole

Moksha.title: Moksha
Moksha.definition: Liberation; freedom from the cycle of rebirth; union with the divine; the ultimate goal of spirituality

Jnana.title: Jnana
Jnana.definition: Knowledge; wisdom; understanding of ultimate reality; direct perception of truth

Maya.title: Maya
Maya.definition: Illusion; the power of appearance; what veils the ultimate reality; the material nature

Tapas.title: Tapas
Tapas.definition: Austerity; heat of discipline; practices that purify; spiritual effort and discipline
